cvWarningsTitle: Worth a look before you send this

cvWarning.noSections: The CV has no recognisable sections, so the opening could not be checked.
cvWarning.impactZoneWords: The opening runs to {{count}} words; a recruiter reads about 120 before deciding.
cvWarning.bulletBand: A bullet under "{{role}}" is {{count}} words; {{min}}–{{max}} reads best.
cvWarning.metricFallback: "{{role}}": {{count}} of {{total}} bullets carry no number, though your record has some.
cvWarning.photoInvented: The CV contains an image. Remove it unless you added it yourself.
cvWarning.dobInvented: The CV states a date of birth that is not in your record.
cvWarning.consentInvented: The CV states a data-processing consent line that is not in your record.
cvWarning.gaps: The job asks for these, and your record does not evidence them — they were left off rather than faked: {{list}}
cvWarning.projectsNoOverride: A Projects section appears without a reason to use one.
cvWarning.summaryNoAchievements: The summary carries no achievement bullets — the first 120 words are the space a recruiter actually reads.
cvWarning.summaryTooManyAchievements: The summary lists {{count}} achievements; three is the ceiling before the opening stops being scannable.
cvWarning.summaryAchievementNoRole: {{count}} summary achievement(s) do not name the role they came from, so they read as floating claims.
cvWarning.earlierCareerNoEmployer: The Earlier Career line names no real employer — a recognisable name there is the strongest thing on that line.
cvWarning.identityEpithet: The opening describes you rather than what you did: {{list}}. Lead with a fact instead.
cvWarning.summaryVerbatimCopy: {{count}} summary achievement(s) repeat a work-experience bullet word for word. Same result, said differently, reads far better.
cvWarning.missingMonth: Your record gives no month for {{list}}, so the year stands alone rather than being guessed. Add the month if you know it.
